steps.cmd: BIN design.bcd pmi fits (pmi (node 1) (temp cold 20) (fit seat 1 n1.c1.wall.0.0 2 n2.c0.wall.0.0 H7/h5 clearance))

fits 1
fit seat hole 1.n1.c1.wall.0.0 H7=[22, 22.021] shaft 2.n2.c0.wall.0.0 h5=[21.991, 22] nominal=22
  temp cold T=20 clearance=[0, 0.030000000000000002]
